Full command (run verbatim from project root):
PATH="$PWD/.runtime/bin:$PATH" TMPDIR="$PWD/.test-tmp" .runtime/bin/node .runtime/lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js test

Actual outcome: exit code 1.
- All 122 importer cases PASS (PASS 001-122 printed: 110 grouping samples, BOM/CRLF/blank/whitespace, 6 invalid amounts incl. 90071992547409.92, sum overflow, category overflow, extra column, empty category, invalid header).
